SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.`reason_code` = 'STOCKOUT' AND r.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS' THEN r.`order_id` END) AS stockout_refund_order_cnt,
    SUM(s.`order_cnt`) AS total_order_cnt
FROM `trd_daily_shop_sales` s
JOIN `dim_shop` sh ON s.`shop_id` = sh.`id`
JOIN `prd_brand` b ON sh.`brand_id` = b.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` reg ON sh.`region_id` = reg.`id`
LEFT JOIN `trd_refund` r ON r.`order_id` = s.`shop_id` 
    AND r.`applied_at` >= '2026-10-12' AND r.`applied_at` < '2026-10-19'
    AND r.`reason_code` = 'STOCKOUT' 
    AND r.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
WHERE b.`name` = '曜石'
    AND reg.`big_region` = '华东'
    AND s.`stat_date` >= '2026-10-12' AND s.`stat_date` < '2026-10-19';

SELECT `mkt_activity`.`target_gmv`, `mkt_activity`.`budget`, `mkt_activity`.`status`
FROM `mkt_activity`
JOIN `trd_order_promotion` ON `mkt_activity`.`id` = `trd_order_promotion`.`activity_id`
JOIN `trd_order` ON `trd_order_promotion`.`order_id` = `trd_order`.`id`
JOIN `dim_shop` ON `trd_order`.`shop_id` = `dim_shop`.`id`
JOIN `prd_brand` ON `dim_shop`.`brand_id` = `prd_brand`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` ON `dim_shop`.`region_id` = `dim_region`.`id`
WHERE `prd_brand`.`name` = '曜石'
  AND `dim_region`.`big_region` = '华东'
  AND `mkt_activity`.`name` = '2026双11'
  AND `mkt_activity`.`start_at` <= '2026-10-18'
  AND `mkt_activity`.`end_at` >= '2026-10-12';
